say:3:1410301001:1.text: Zanie, have we reached the surface yet?
say:3:1410301001:1.source_cn: 祖娅，我们这是到地表了吗？

say:4:1410301002:1.text: Haha! Not even close, little guy. We're still way underground.
say:4:1410301002:1.source_cn: 哈哈！这才哪到哪？我们还在地底呢。

say:5:1410301003:1.text: But don't worry, your fearless guide knows the way! Just stick close and try not to get too distracted by all the weird and wonderful sights.
say:5:1410301003:1.source_cn: 距离目的地还远得很，得走一段路！跟我来！

say:6:1410301004:1.text: It's so fascinating... The scenery here is completely different from the mine! It's almost like we've stepped into a whole other world.
say:6:1410301004:1.source_cn: 好奇妙，这里的景色和矿洞里完全不同，简直像另一种地面的世界。

say:7:1410301005:1.text: The mushrooms here are taller than trees! How do they even grow this big?!
say:7:1410301005:1.source_cn: 蘑菇比树还高……真想知道它们是怎么长这么大的！

say:8:1410301006:1.text: Look all you want, just don't get any ideas about taste-testing them, okay? Most plants down here are highly toxic. One wrong bite, and you could end up as a glowing hamster!
say:8:1410301006:1.source_cn: 看归看，可不要乱吃啊。地底的植物毒性可大着呢！一不小心...

say:9:1410301007:1.text: A glowing Hammie... That would make a pretty cool floor lamp. Haha!
say:9:1410301007:1.source_cn: 发光的漫漫啊……感觉会是个很好看的落地灯，嘿嘿——

say:10:1410301008:1.text: Perfect to light things up in the Mystical House!
say:10:1410301008:1.source_cn: 适合摆在神秘屋里最显眼的位置！

say:11:1410301009:1.text: Stupid Chippy! Stop daydreaming! And I don't want to be a floor lamp!
say:11:1410301009:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满！停止你的想象！我才不要当落地灯！

say:0:1410302001:0.text: But even without sunlight, it's still so bright down here... Where's all this light coming from?
say:0:1410302001:0.source_cn: 虽然是地底，但是很明亮诶，明明照不到太阳……

say:1:1410302002:0.text: The underground is a marvel, isn't it? Many plants and minerals glow!
say:1:1410302002:0.source_cn: 地底可是很神奇的，很多植物和矿物都会发光！

say:1:1410303002:0.text: Oho! Keen hamster senses at work! That scent... If I had to guess, it's lichen.
say:1:1410303002:0.source_cn: 仓鼠的鼻子真灵，看前面，我猜是地衣的味道。

say:4:1410305002:0.text: Yes. That's what they call themselves. They've lived underground for who knows how long.
say:4:1410305002:0.source_cn: 嗯，他们自称艾塞勒，一直生活在地下。
say:4:1410305002:0.male: Yes. That's what they call themselves. They've lived underground for who knows how long.
say:4:1410305002:0.female: Yes. That's what they call themselves. They've lived underground for who knows how long.

say:5:1410305003:0.text: Whoa! His skin is all pale and gray! Chippy almost thought he was a Graveborn!
say:5:1410305003:0.source_cn: 这个人皮肤灰白，乍一看，满满还以为他是亡灵！

say:6:1410305004:0.text: Stay underground your whole life without ever seeing the sun, and you'd look like that too.
say:6:1410305004:0.source_cn: 要是你长期不见阳光，皮肤也会灰白得吓人。
say:6:1410305004:0.male: Stay underground your whole life without ever seeing the sun, and you'd look like that too.
say:6:1410305004:0.female: Stay underground your whole life without ever seeing the sun, and you'd look like that too.

say:7:1410305005:0.text: Not that it'd matter for you two. You're covered in fluff. Even if you turned white, who would notice?
say:7:1410305005:0.source_cn: 哦，不过你有一身毛发，就算皮肤再白也看不出来。
say:7:1410305005:0.male: Not that it'd matter for you two. You're covered in fluff. Even if you turned white, who would notice?

say:13:1410305009:0.female: Ugh! There it is! That suspicious look of yours is so annoying!

say:18:1410305013:0.source_cn: 他这是病还是伤……总之挺严重。我皮糙肉厚，没生过病，不...

choice:8:0:1.male: Tell me more about the Essail.
choice:8:0:1.female: Tell me more about the Essail.

say:4:1410306002:1.male: Hey! That's so rude! The magister just saved you!
say:4:1410306002:1.female: Hey! That's so rude! The magister just saved you!

say:14:1410306009:1.text: Sir, you're badly injured. What happened to you?
say:14:1410306009:1.source_cn: 这位先生，你伤得好重啊，发生什么了？

say:15:1410306010:1.text: I was... punished. Branded with a Stigma of Judgment. I haven't had any dew for days...
say:15:1410306010:1.source_cn: 我受到了……惩罚。我被烙上了象征罪恶的印记，已经好几天...

choice_prompt:16:1410306010.text: I was... punished. Branded with a Stigma of Judgment. I haven't had any dew for days...

say:31:1410306022:1.source_cn: 孽化……？第一次听说。你们艾塞勒神神秘秘的，就连生病都...

say:32:1410306023:1.text: *Cough* I... I have to leave! If my master sends him after me! He'll...!
say:32:1410306023:1.source_cn: 咳咳咳，我得、我得离开……！如果主人让那家伙把我抓回去...

say:33:1410306024:1.text: Wait, sir, uh, what's your name?
say:33:1410306024:1.source_cn: 先别着急，这位先生……呃，你叫什么名字？

say:35:1410306026:1.text: He's going to come after me! If I'm caught... I might as well be dead already! Please, help me—no... save me!
say:35:1410306026:1.source_cn: 我不能被那家伙抓到！否则我只有死路一条！求求你们！帮我...

say:36:1410306027:1.text: Alright, slow down. Who exactly is <style="highlight">he</style>?

say:3:1410308001:0.text: Halt! I am Indris, Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard.
say:3:1410308001:0.source_cn: 你们几个，站住。我乃因度厄，艾塞勒一族的卫队长。

say:4:1410308002:1.text: You've been involved with a Sinned One. This matter touches upon our clan's deepest secrets. I cannot allow you to leave without consequences.
say:4:1410308002:1.source_cn: 你们参与了对孽化者的处理，此事涉及我族秘辛，我不能放你们走。

say:5:1410308003:1.text: Wait, are you talking about that kid turning into a monster before our eyes?
say:5:1410308003:1.source_cn: 你说的秘辛，是指那孩子在我们眼前变成了怪物？

say:6:1410308004:0.text: I've seen that before... I thought it was some rare underground species. Could it be... they were originally your people? An Essail?
say:6:1410308004:0.source_cn: 我曾见过那种怪物，我还以为是什么稀有的地下物种。难道…...

say:7:1410308005:1.text: ... I can't disclose that. But now you're involved.
say:7:1410308005:1.source_cn: ……我不便透露。但你们牵涉到了其中——

say:8:1410308006:1.text: You must come with me to <style="highlight">Sal'thorin</style>. The High Priestess will decide what happens next.

say:9:1410308007:1.text: That's a very suspicious request! We're not going anywhere with you!
say:9:1410308007:1.source_cn: 这么可疑的要求，我们才不会跟你走！

say:10:1410308008:1.text: Don't complicate things. I'd rather not resort to force.
say:10:1410308008:1.source_cn: 不要让事情变得复杂，我不想动手。

say:11:1410308009:0.text: Hey! What's with that tone? There are four of us here!
say:11:1410308009:0.source_cn: 喂，你什么口气啊……我们这里可是有4个人！

say:12:1410308010:1.text: So, you'd rather resolve this with violence?

say:15:1410308012:0.text: The place where my people reside. It's a sanctuary untouched by conflict, pain, or corruption.
say:15:1410308012:0.source_cn: 我族居住的地方名为萨洛克兰。那是远离纷争、痛苦和污秽的...

say:16:1410308013:1.text: I'm simply following protocol. There's no reason to be nervous. The High Priestess is merciful and kind...
say:16:1410308013:1.source_cn: 我也是例行公事，你们无需紧张。祭司冕下宽容慈爱……

say:17:1410308014:1.text: And given the special contributions the dwarves have made to our people, she'll certainly not be harsh with you.
say:17:1410308014:1.source_cn: 再加上矮人一族为我族做出的特殊贡献，她绝不会刁难你们。

say:25:1410321022:1.text: But when that dwarf called you Aunt, Chippy almost fell over! You don't look nearly old enough for that!
say:25:1410321022:1.source_cn: 不过，那位矮人叫你姑姑的时候把我吓了一跳，你怎么看也不...

say:26:1410321023:1.text: Well... I can't help it if I look young.
say:26:1410321023:1.source_cn: 这个……长、长得年轻，也不能怪我啊。

say:27:1410321024:1.text: Enough about that. The lift's waiting, so let's get a move on!
say:27:1410321024:1.source_cn: 不说这些，被小插曲耽误了一段时间，咱们去坐升降机吧。

choice:10:0:1.text: She doesn't seem like a threat.
choice:10:0:1.male: She doesn't seem like a threat.
choice:10:0:1.female: She doesn't seem like a threat.

narration:0:1410322101:0.text: Meanwhile, in the royal court of Sal'thorin...
narration:0:1410322101:0.source_cn: 此时，萨洛克兰的王庭中……

say:3:1410323001:0.text: Velara, you summoned us all here for something this trivial?
say:3:1410323001:0.source_cn: 奎茵，你把所有人都叫来，竟然只为了这点小事？

say:4:1410323002:1.text: Ravion, this concerns the safety of Sal'thorin. We cannot afford to be reckless.
say:4:1410323002:1.source_cn: 沙利叶，事关萨洛克兰的安危，不能掉以轻心。

say:5:1410323003:0.text: Ah, how I envy you, Thador. Standing at the gate all day must give you plenty of time to polish your sense of self-importance.
say:5:1410323003:0.source_cn: 哎呀，真羡慕你，正因为做着守门人这种闲差事，才有精力对...

say:6:1410323004:0.text: Perhaps you should focus on your actual duty. If any rats sneak into the royal halls, I'd hate to see your reputation suffer.
say:6:1410323004:0.source_cn: 劝你还是安心守好的你的门，王城里的事少插嘴。要是真有什...

say:7:1410323005:0.text: Sometimes, I wonder if you're truly Her Majesty's son. Do you even care about Sal'thorin?
say:7:1410323005:0.source_cn: 沙利叶，我常常怀疑你到底是不是女王陛下的儿子，你心里究...

say:8:1410323006:1.text: Sal'thorin will be just fine without me wringing my hands over every little inconvenience.
say:8:1410323006:1.source_cn: 用不着一口一个萨洛克兰，现在萨洛克兰好好的。

say:9:1410323007:1.text: But Velara, all this over a handful of surface dwellers?
say:9:1410323007:1.source_cn: 倒是奎茵，你打算为了一群微不足道的地表人让因度厄大动干戈。

say:10:1410323008:1.text: If you want to have Indris do your dirty work, go right ahead. Just don't forget to reward him handsomely.
say:10:1410323008:1.source_cn: 你想要差使因度厄替你干点脏活儿，随意，只要别忘了给他些奖赏。

say:11:1410323009:1.text: I simply never expected such a small matter to rattle you and Thador so much. Tsk, tsk... Embarrassing, truly.
say:11:1410323009:1.source_cn: 但我实在没想到，这么点小事都能把你和都铎吓破胆子。唉，...

say:12:1410323010:0.text: There are many among our kin who resent toplanders setting foot in Sal'thorin. Ignoring their voices would be unwise.
say:12:1410323010:0.source_cn: 不少同胞都反对地表人踏足萨洛克兰，我们不能对这些声音充...

say:13:1410323011:0.text: If the dwarf was the only one to witness the corruption, I might have allowed this to pass.
say:13:1410323011:0.source_cn: 如果只有矮人目击到孽化，我可以考虑作罢。

say:14:1410323012:0.text: But one of them... <style="stress"><player_name></style>... he is no dwarf. And the one who brought him is equally suspect.
say:14:1410323012:0.male: But one of them... <style="stress"><player_name></style>... he is no dwarf. And the one who brought him is equally suspect.
say:14:1410323012:0.female: But one of them... <style="stress"><player_name></style>... she is no dwarf. And the one who brought her is equally suspect.

say:15:1410323013:0.text: I will not permit unknown variables to endanger Sal'thorin. They must be eliminated.
say:15:1410323013:0.source_cn: 我决不允许任何变数威胁萨洛克兰，<male>他</ma...
say:15:1410323013:0.male: I will not permit unknown variables to endanger Sal'thorin. They must be eliminated.
say:15:1410323013:0.female: I will not permit unknown variables to endanger Sal'thorin. They must be eliminated.

say:19:1410323017:0.text: Now, now. Why so tense? If you vote against it, then I'll change my vote to support it. Would you like to try?
say:19:1410323017:0.source_cn: 怎么生气了？如果你投反对票，那我就改为赞成。你要不要试试看？

say:24:1410323019:0.text: ... Your Majesty! Regarding the matter at hand—

say:27:1410323021:0.text: Velara, you will see to it.

say:29:1410323022:0.text: As you command, Your Majesty. Your will shall ever guide us.
say:29:1410323022:0.source_cn: ……遵命，您的意志永远指引我们。

say:3:1410329001:1.text: Who sent Indris to stop us? Could it be that High Priestess?
say:3:1410329001:1.source_cn: 是谁派因度厄小哥来阻拦我们……难道是那个漂亮的大祭司？

say:4:1410329002:1.text: But she told us to leave back then...
say:4:1410329002:1.source_cn: 可她当时让我们离开了……

say:5:1410329003:1.text: When we first entered the royal city, that rude Essail mentioned they had three Exarchs. Maybe someone else made the call?
say:5:1410329003:1.source_cn: 刚进王城时，有个粗鲁的艾塞勒提过他们有三长老，莫非是其...

say:6:1410329004:1.text: Whoever it is, if they dare threaten our magister, Chippy won't forgive them!
say:6:1410329004:1.source_cn: 不管是谁，竟然想伤害主人！满满饶不了他们！
say:6:1410329004:1.male: Whoever it is, if they dare threaten our magister, Chippy won't forgive them!
say:6:1410329004:1.female: Whoever it is, if they dare threaten our magister, Chippy won't forgive them!

say:7:1410329005:1.text: Chippy, you're puffing up your cheeks again!

say:8:1410329006:1.text: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!
say:8:1410329006:1.source_cn: 主人，好不容易回到地面，赶紧联系霍根将军吧。
say:8:1410329006:1.male: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!
say:8:1410329006:1.female: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!

choice_prompt:9:1410329006.text: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!
choice_prompt:9:1410329006.source_cn: 主人，好不容易回到地面，赶紧联系霍根将军吧。
choice_prompt:9:1410329006.male: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!
choice_prompt:9:1410329006.female: We finally made it back to the surface. Let's contact General Hogan!

say:11:1410329007:0.text: Oh? What's this little gizmo? How intriguing!
say:11:1410329007:0.male: Oh? What's this little gizmo? How intriguing!
say:11:1410329007:0.female: Oh? What's this little gizmo? How intriguing!

say:12:1410329008:0.text: The craftsmanship is precise, the structure is intricate, and the mechanism runs without a hitch! Also... this handiwork looks awfully familiar...
say:12:1410329008:0.source_cn: 做工精密，结构细致，运作流畅，也没有任何故障！另外，这...

say:13:1410329009:0.text: Hugin made it! He's a brilliant dwarven craftsman we know. Our magister also enchanted it.
say:13:1410329009:0.source_cn: 通讯器是呼金先生做的，呼金先生是一位很厉害的矮人工匠。...
say:13:1410329009:0.male: Hugin made it! He's a brilliant dwarven craftsman we know. Our magister also enchanted it.
say:13:1410329009:0.female: Hugin made it! He's a brilliant dwarven craftsman we know. Our magister also enchanted it.

say:16:1410329011:1.text: Know him? Please! We're practically family!
say:16:1410329011:1.source_cn: 哪止认识？熟得不能再熟了！
say:16:1410329011:1.male: Know him? Please! We're practically family!
say:16:1410329011:1.female: Know him? Please! We're practically family!

say:17:1410329012:0.source_cn: 我曾经有过一个徒弟——就是呼金！

say:18:1410329013:1.text: Hugin always talks about his master... I never expected it to be you!
say:18:1410329013:1.source_cn: 呼金总是和我们提起自己的老师。没想到竟然是你！

say:19:1410329014:1.text: That's right! What a stroke of fate! So you know that brat too!
say:19:1410329014:1.source_cn: 是啊！太巧了，你们居然认识那孩子。

say:20:1410329015:1.text: But Zanie, Hugin has a huge beard, and you're so... young... Are you really his master?
say:20:1410329015:1.source_cn: 可是祖娅，呼金长着一把大胡子，你却这么年轻……你还是他...

say:21:1410329016:1.text: What's this? Interrogating a lady's age again? Where are your manners, little hamster?
say:21:1410329016:1.source_cn: 干嘛，又想打探我的年龄？不许问！要做绅士仓鼠！

say:22:1410329017:1.text: Stop staring at me! Contact your friend already!
say:22:1410329017:1.source_cn: 别盯着看我了！快联系你们的特使大人！

choice_prompt:23:1410329017.text: Stop staring at me! Contact your friend already!
choice_prompt:23:1410329017.source_cn: 别盯着看我了！快联系你们的特使大人！

say:24:1410329018:1.text: You wait for a while, but Hogan doesn't pick up...
say:24:1410329018:1.source_cn: 等了很久，霍根始终未应答……

say:26:1410329020:1.text: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.
say:26:1410329020:1.source_cn: 难道是机械故障？让我看看通讯器。
say:26:1410329020:1.male: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.
say:26:1410329020:1.female: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.

choice_prompt:27:1410329020.text: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.
choice_prompt:27:1410329020.source_cn: 难道是机械故障？让我看看通讯器。
choice_prompt:27:1410329020.male: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.
choice_prompt:27:1410329020.female: Could it be a mechanical failure? Let me take a look.

say:28:1410329021:1.text: Hmm... Bearings are smooth, screws are tight, and not a single wire is out of place.
say:28:1410329021:1.source_cn: 嗯……轴承顺滑，螺钮紧实，功能好着呢。

say:29:1410329022:1.text: Magister... Could something have happened to General Hogan?
say:29:1410329022:1.source_cn: 主人……霍根将军该不会出事了吧？
say:29:1410329022:1.male: Magister... Could something have happened to General Hogan?
say:29:1410329022:1.female: Magister... Could something have happened to General Hogan?

say:30:1410329023:1.text: Relax! A full-grown knight doesn't just vanish into thin air. But if he disappeared in the village...
say:30:1410329023:1.source_cn: 别担心。一个大活人不可能这么容易消失。既然他是在村子里...

say:31:1410329024:1.text: Then I'll help you search! I know the place like the back of my hand!
say:31:1410329024:1.source_cn: 那我就帮你们一起找找看吧！这里我更熟！

say:32:1410329025:1.text: I'll hold onto this little gadget for now. If I find anything, I'll call you. You do have extras, right?
say:32:1410329025:1.source_cn: 这个小可爱我先拿着，要是有什么结果，我们就用它联系。我...

say:33:1410329026:1.text: Yes, we do. Let's hurry and find General Hogan! Zanie, he's a valiant knight wearing armor and carrying a greatsword.
say:33:1410329026:1.source_cn: 好，那我们赶紧去找霍根将军吧。祖娅，霍根将军是一位身着...

say:34:1410329027:1.text: Got it! I'll search carefully. You lot be careful too!
say:34:1410329027:1.source_cn: 记住了！我好好找，你们也多加小心。

say:0:1410330001:0.text: Could he have returned to Holistone?
say:0:1410330001:0.source_cn: 难道霍根将军先回圣石镇了？

say:1:1410330002:0.text: Let's check if the ship is still there.
say:1:1410330002:0.male: Let's check if the ship is still there.
say:1:1410330002:0.female: Let's check if the ship is still there.

say:3:1410333001:1.text: Mr. Ironbeard! Sorry to bother you, but have you seen General Hogan?
say:3:1410333001:1.source_cn: 铁须先生，打扰了！你有没有见过霍根将军？

say:4:1410333002:1.text: Bah! How should I know? Don't bother me! I'm up to my beard in work!
say:4:1410333002:1.source_cn: 不知道！别来问我，我忙死了！

say:5:1410333003:1.text: A supply shortage at a time like this... It's a disaster! Our entire production line's slowing to a crawl!
say:5:1410333003:1.source_cn: 这个节骨眼上原料供应短缺……已经严重影响到我们的生产进度了！

say:9:1410333005:1.text: He stormed off in a rage...

choice_prompt:10:1410333005.text: He stormed off in a rage...

say:11:1410333006:1.text: The supply shortage... It couldn't have been caused by us, could it?
say:11:1410333006:1.source_cn: 原料供应短缺……不会是我们造成的吧？

say:12:1410333007:1.text: No time to worry about that! General Hogan's missing!
say:12:1410333007:1.source_cn: 现在哪有时间替他们担心，我们得赶紧找到霍根将军。

say:3:1410334001:1.text: Hello, Ms. Hyla! Have you seen General Hogan today?
say:3:1410334001:1.source_cn: 你好，海拉女士，请问你今天是否见过霍根将军？

say:4:1410334002:1.text: Huh? Oh, you guys! The envoys from the Empire! Weren't you with him?
say:4:1410334002:1.source_cn: 你们——哦，想起来了！耀光来的使节大人们！你们没有在一...

say:5:1410334003:1.text: You'd better ask Eldric. I've got work to do!
say:5:1410334003:1.source_cn: 这种事得去问弗林！我只关心工作！

choice_prompt:6:1410334003.text: You'd better ask Eldric. I've got work to do!
choice_prompt:6:1410334003.source_cn: 这种事得去问弗林！我只关心工作！

say:7:1410334004:1.text: Either in the village or the mine...
say:7:1410334004:1.source_cn: 不是在村里就是在矿洞里……

say:8:1410334005:1.text: I hope he's in the mine! He should be handling the echorite shortage!
say:8:1410334005:1.source_cn: 我倒希望他在矿洞里，他是该抓紧处理深岩晶供应不足的问题！

say:9:1410334006:1.text: The smelting furnaces can't sit idle! We've got a mountain of orders piling up!
say:9:1410334006:1.source_cn: 冶炼所的熔炉可不能空转，我们的订单已经堆积了好大一批！

say:10:1410334007:1.text: We dwarves don't just take pride in our craftsmanship, we take pride in our reputation and honor as well!
say:10:1410334007:1.source_cn: 信誉！我们矮人引以为豪的可不只是工艺，还有信誉！

say:1:1410336001:0.text: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?
say:1:1410336001:0.male: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?
say:1:1410336001:0.female: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?

say:2:1410336002:1.text: Didn't expect to run into you here. How are you faring?
say:2:1410336002:1.source_cn: 没想到，能在这碰见……你们身体恢复了吗？

say:4:1410336003:1.text: Thanks for asking! We're all doing well.
say:4:1410336003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的关心，我们一切都好。

say:5:1410336004:2.text: Good, good! And how'd the inspection go? If you've still got an appetite for knowledge, I'd be honored to give you another tour.
say:5:1410336004:2.source_cn: 视察了一番，还满意吗？我再陪你们四处看看？

choice_prompt:6:1410336004.text: Good, good! And how'd the inspection go? If you've still got an appetite for knowledge, I'd be honored to give you another tour.
choice_prompt:6:1410336004.source_cn: 视察了一番，还满意吗？我再陪你们四处看看？

say:7:1410336005:0.text: Huh? The general didn't tell you himself? Must've been in quite the rush.
say:7:1410336005:0.source_cn: 嗯？霍根将军什么都没说吗？一定是他走得太急了。

say:8:1410336006:0.text: He received word of an urgent matter and set sail back to Holistone immediately.
say:8:1410336006:0.source_cn: 将军大人他收到了传信，说是有什么突发状况，已经返航圣石镇了。

say:9:1410336007:0.text: If all's gone well, he should be more than halfway there by now.
say:9:1410336007:0.source_cn: 要是一路顺风的话，估计航程都过半了。

choice_prompt:10:1410336007.text: If all's gone well, he should be more than halfway there by now.
choice_prompt:10:1410336007.source_cn: 要是一路顺风的话，估计航程都过半了。

say:11:1410336008:0.text: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.
say:11:1410336008:0.source_cn: 这种大事，我怎么有胆子骗特使大人呢！
say:11:1410336008:0.male: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.
say:11:1410336008:0.female: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.

say:12:1410336009:0.text: Alright, if you need reassurance—by Dura's name, I swear it!
say:12:1410336009:0.source_cn: 嗯，这样吧，我以艾雅之名起誓！

choice_prompt:13:1410336009.text: Alright, if you need reassurance—by Dura's name, I swear it!
choice_prompt:13:1410336009.source_cn: 嗯，这样吧，我以艾雅之名起誓！

say:14:1410336010:1.text: Well, uh... I mentioned Dura because it would put you Empire people more at ease!
say:14:1410336010:1.source_cn: 这就有点……我的意思是，向两位神明起誓也不太好吧？

say:16:1410336011:0.text: You say he left, but the ship we arrived on is still docked.
say:16:1410336011:0.source_cn: 你说霍根将军走了，那为什么我们来时乘坐的船还在？

say:17:1410336012:0.text: That's right! If he's gone, what ship did he take?
say:17:1410336012:0.source_cn: 没错，霍根将军到底是怎么离开的？

say:19:1410336013:2.text: Ours, of course! It's much sturdier and built to withstand these unruly tides. I can't have the general risking his neck on a less seaworthy vessel.
say:19:1410336013:2.source_cn: 当然是乘坐我们的船了，我们的船更加坚固，最近海面上风浪...

say:20:1410336014:0.text: Oh, speaking of which, I'll need to arrange proper transport for you as well. Head to the armory and wait there. I'll handle the rest.
say:20:1410336014:0.source_cn: 对了对了，我也得为你们准备一艘船。请在装备库旁稍等，我...

say:23:1410336015:0.text: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
say:23:1410336015:0.source_cn: 主人，我认为弗林在撒谎。霍根将军可能出事了……
say:23:1410336015:0.male: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
say:23:1410336015:0.female: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...

choice_prompt:24:1410336015.text: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
choice_prompt:24:1410336015.source_cn: 主人，我认为弗林在撒谎。将军可能出事了……
choice_prompt:24:1410336015.male: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
choice_prompt:24:1410336015.female: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...

say:25:1410336016:0.source_cn: 这里人多眼杂，我们得找个隐秘的地方。

say:0:1410337001:0.text: Let's find somewhere secluded so we can talk to her safely.
say:0:1410337001:0.source_cn: 找个没人的地方联络祖娅吧。
say:0:1410337001:0.male: Let's find somewhere secluded so we can talk to her safely.
say:0:1410337001:0.female: Let's find somewhere secluded so we can talk to her safely.

say:0:1410340001:0.source_cn: 准备好再次去地下了吗？

say:0:1410343001:0.text: He's been defeated. Let's ignore him and move on!
say:0:1410343001:0.source_cn: 这家伙被打败了，不管他了，我们先走吧！
say:0:1410343001:0.male: He's been defeated. Let's ignore him and move on!
say:0:1410343001:0.female: He's been defeated. Let's ignore him and move on!

say:0:1410344001:0.text: What's next? Split up and gather info?
say:0:1410344001:0.source_cn: 接下来要怎么做？分头打听吗？
say:0:1410344001:0.male: What's next? Split up and gather info?
say:0:1410344001:0.female: What's next? Split up and gather info?

say:1:1410344002:0.text: I'll disguise myself as an Essail. You handle the dwarves!
say:1:1410344002:0.source_cn: 我装扮成艾塞勒一族试试，矮人那边就拜托你了！有什么消息...
say:1:1410344002:0.male: I'll disguise myself as an Essail. You handle the dwarves!
say:1:1410344002:0.female: I'll disguise myself as an Essail. You handle the dwarves!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410313001:.text: To our good health, General Hogan!

narration:4:1410314001:2.text: Hogan gets knocked out, and the communicator you gave him doesn't stay hidden for long...
narration:4:1410314001:2.source_cn: 霍根被毒晕了过去，你赠予他的通讯器随后也被搜了出来……

cinematic_dialogue:6:1410313001:.text: To our good health, General Hogan!

say:9:1410314002:1.text: Chief, we found this on the general. It's quite similar to our own technology.
say:9:1410314002:1.source_cn: 弗林，我们在霍根身上找到了这个，看起来也是我们的技术。

say:11:1410314003:1.text: A flimsy trinket from an untrustworthy source. Destroy it.
say:11:1410314003:1.source_cn: 嗤，旁门左道的小玩意儿，销毁吧。

say:12:1410314004:0.text: And make sure the general gets handed over to our partners—clean and quiet, just like we discussed.
say:12:1410314004:0.source_cn: 记得把霍根交给我们亲爱的合作伙伴，我相信他们会处理干净的。

say:13:1410314005:0.text: Do you really think the Empire will just let this go?
say:13:1410314005:0.source_cn: 特使被我们……耀光那边能交代得了吗？

say:14:1410314006:0.text: Don't be so quick to underestimate our friends, Roban. Our partners have a way of making things disappear.
say:14:1410314006:0.source_cn: 别忘了，我们的合作伙伴可不止地底那群灰老鼠。

say:15:1410314007:0.text: It's time for our allies in Savannah to pay their dues. Let's see how they handle it.
say:15:1410314007:0.source_cn: 赛凡纳的朋友也该回报点什么了。

narration:17:14010322:0.text: Roban brings over the wine, poison and all. Hogan takes a swig, grins, and then passes out.
narration:17:14010322:0.source_cn: 矮人隆多拿来美酒，谁知酒里有毒，霍根喝下后晕了过去。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317201:.text: By the Queen's grace, may these crude stones be—
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317201:.source_cn: 女王在上，赐予这些粗糙的石材——

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317202:.text: Always Queen this and Queen that...
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317202:.source_cn: 又来了！整天把女王挂嘴边

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410317204:.text: Huh? Wait a second, is that...

say:6:1410319001:0.text: Aunt Zanie... is it really you?
say:6:1410319001:0.source_cn: 祖娅姑姑……真的是祖娅姑姑吗？

say:9:1410319003:1.text: Aunt Zanie! It's really you! Helthor's beard, I can't believe my eyes!
say:9:1410319003:1.source_cn: 姑姑！真是你！赫托在下……我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！

say:10:1410319004:1.text: Uh. W-wrong person! Never seen you before in my life!

say:11:1410319005:1.text: Oh, come on! It's me! Finn! You know, the kid who stole your wine, and then you walloped me so hard I saw stars!
say:11:1410319005:1.source_cn: 怎么会？是我啊！芬恩！小时候我偷喝你的酒，还被你狠狠打...

say:12:1410319006:1.text: Helthor's hammer, <style="highlight">you haven't aged a day in a hundred years!</style>

say:13:1410319007:1.text: Where in the underground have you been all these years? No word, no message! Even Eldric wouldn't tell me anything!
say:13:1410319007:1.source_cn: 这么些年你去哪了？一点消息都没有！弗林什么都不肯说。

say:14:1410319008:1.text: Speaking of Eldric, he's chief now! After you left he—
say:14:1410319008:1.source_cn: 说起来，你走之后，弗林就当上了村长。要我说——

say:18:1410319009:1.text: Toplander! If you have time to chat, you have time to work! No slacking!
say:18:1410319009:1.source_cn: 地表人！你还有闲心聊天？快干活！不要偷懒！

say:19:1410319010:1.text: Hey! Who do you think you're talking to? I'm no servant of yours! Try showing some respect!
say:19:1410319010:1.source_cn: 嘿，你说谁呢？我可不是你们的仆从！放尊重点！

say:20:1410319011:1.text: Don't forget, it was you dwarves who came begging for echorites! Without Her Majesty's generosity, you'd be left with nothing!
say:20:1410319011:1.source_cn: 别忘了，是你们矮人喊着求着想要深岩晶！如果不是女王开恩...

say:21:1410319012:1.text: Without our magic, your so-called "craftsmanship" is just lifeless rock!
say:21:1410319012:1.source_cn: 没有我们的魔法，你们造的东西不过是堆死石头！

say:22:1410319013:1.text: Excuse me?! If it weren't for us dwarves, you Essail wouldn't even have a city to strut around in!
say:22:1410319013:1.source_cn: 哈？！要不是我们矮人，你们这群尖耳朵怕是连个遮风挡雨的...

say:23:1410319014:1.text: Look at these arches, these pillars. Every single one is the work of my ancestors!
say:23:1410319014:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧这些拱门和立柱，哪一块不是我们祖辈的心血？

say:24:1410319015:1.text: Watch your tongue! The fact that we allowed your kind to work on this sacred project is already an act of mercy!
say:24:1410319015:1.source_cn: 注意你的语气。让你们这些地表种族参与神圣工程，已是莫大...

say:25:1410319016:1.text: Oh please! So what? The temple is sacred, but somehow, your royal city isn't.
say:25:1410319016:1.source_cn: 得了吧！建神殿才是神圣工程，给你们修王城算什么神圣？

say:26:1410319017:1.text: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?
say:26:1410319017:1.source_cn: 怎么，喝几口灵露就把自己当神了？
say:26:1410319017:1.male: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?
say:26:1410319017:1.female: What? Drinking a few drops of Divine Dew makes you gods now?

say:27:1410319018:1.text: Enough! You'll hold your tongue and prepare the stones!

say:29:1410319019:1.text: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!
say:29:1410319019:1.male: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!
say:29:1410319019:1.female: Oh yeah? Make me! I'm on break!

say:31:1410319020:1.source_cn: 你！那你就永远地休息吧！

narration:36:14010399:0.text: Nearby, an Essail is offering a prayer over a stone and starts arguing with a dwarf. You happen to walk by, and the dwarf immediately recognizes Zanie.
narration:36:14010399:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒祭司对着石材祝祷时，与旁边的矮人吵了起来。你们恰...
narration:36:14010399:0.male: Nearby, an Essail is offering a prayer over a stone and starts arguing with a dwarf. You happen to walk by, and the dwarf immediately recognizes Zanie.
narration:36:14010399:0.female: Nearby, an Essail is offering a prayer over a stone and starts arguing with a dwarf. You happen to walk by, and the dwarf immediately recognizes Zanie.

say:6:1410325001:1.text: High Priestess, they assisted us in containing the corruption. They mean no harm.
say:6:1410325001:1.source_cn: 冕下，这些外来者曾协助我们处理孽化……他们并无恶意。

say:7:1410325002:1.text: The pretense of goodwill is a deception in itself.
say:7:1410325002:1.source_cn: 冒充我们的盟友，这本身就是大罪。

say:8:1410325003:1.text: Indris, you are among the most loyal. Surely, you understand what must be done for Sal'thorin's safety.
say:8:1410325003:1.source_cn: 因度厄，你一向最为忠诚，应该了解什么是对萨洛克兰最好的选择。

say:9:1410325004:1.text: But High Priestess, they seek only to leave. Whether they are deceiving us or not, their departure will not affect our alliances—
say:9:1410325004:1.source_cn: 但冕下，他们似乎只想离开此处。无论冒充与否，都不会影响...

say:10:1410325005:1.text: Enough. Loyalty means not tolerating any danger.
say:10:1410325005:1.source_cn: 够了。忠诚，就不该容忍任何危险的存在。

say:11:1410325006:1.text: They know too much. The corruption, the Divine Dew, our dealings with the dwarves... Shall we gamble the future of Sal'thorin on their silence?
say:11:1410325006:1.source_cn: 他们已经知道了太多。无论是孽化、恩典灵露还是我们和矮人...

say:13:1410325008:1.text: Think of the Queen. Think of our people. Will you defy Her Majesty's will for the sake of outsiders?
say:13:1410325008:1.source_cn: 想想女王，想想萨洛克兰的子民们，你要为了几个外来者违背...

narration:18:14010335:0.text: Priestess Velara strides from the palace, her voice ringing with authority as she commands Indris to hunt you all down without mercy.
narration:18:14010335:0.source_cn: 大祭司奎茵从宫殿中走出，向因度厄下达追杀你们的命令。
narration:18:14010335:0.male: Priestess Velara strides from the palace, her voice ringing with authority as she commands Indris to hunt you all down without mercy.
narration:18:14010335:0.female: Priestess Velara strides from the palace, her voice ringing with authority as she commands Indris to hunt you all down without mercy.

narration:19:14010335:0.female: Priestess Velara strides from the palace, her voice ringing with authority as she commands Indris to hunt you all down without mercy.

say:7:1410326002:1.text: What's the meaning of this, Indris?

say:8:1410326003:1.text: I'm afraid you will never leave Sal'thorin.
say:8:1410326003:1.source_cn: 恐怕，你们得永远留在萨洛克兰了。

say:9:1410326004:1.text: B-but why? We didn't do anything wrong!
say:9:1410326004:1.source_cn: 为什么？我们做错了什么吗？

say:11:1410326006:1.text: You have only two choices. Defeat me, or be defeated by me.
say:11:1410326006:1.source_cn: 打败我，或是被我打败，你们只有这两个选择。

say:15:1410326007:1.text: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!
say:15:1410326007:1.source_cn: 我们才不会被你打败！满满做好准备了，主人，请下令吧！
say:15:1410326007:1.male: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!
say:15:1410326007:1.female: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!

choice_prompt:16:1410326007.text: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!
choice_prompt:16:1410326007.source_cn: 我们才不会被你打败！满满做好准备了，主人，请下令吧！
choice_prompt:16:1410326007.male: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!
choice_prompt:16:1410326007.female: Then Chippy chooses to fight! Magister, just say the word!

choice:16:0:1.text: It seems there's no avoiding this...
choice:16:0:1.male: It seems there's no avoiding this...
choice:16:0:1.female: It seems there's no avoiding this...

narration:19:14010336:0.text: Indris and his men close in just as you make your escape. With no other choice, you steel yourself. It's time to fight your way through.
narration:19:14010336:0.source_cn: 因度厄带人追上了要离开的你们。看来，唯有跟他战斗才能离开了。
narration:19:14010336:0.male: Indris and his men close in just as you make your escape. With no other choice, you steel yourself. It's time to fight your way through.
narration:19:14010336:0.female: Indris and his men close in just as you make your escape. With no other choice, you steel yourself. It's time to fight your way through.

say:1:1410338001:0.source_cn: 主人，就在这里联系祖娅吧！

say:6:1410338003:2.text: Hey! This little gizmo's working like a charm! Hugin's really outdone himself!
say:6:1410338003:2.source_cn: 嘿！这个小玩意儿真不错！呼金出师了！

say:10:1410338004:1.text: Zanie, we couldn't find the general. What about you?
say:10:1410338004:1.source_cn: 祖娅，我们没找到霍根将军。你那边呢？

say:14:1410338005:1.source_cn: 我也在村子里搜了一圈，没什么发现。

say:18:1410338006:1.text: Then he's really disappeared! Could he have already...
say:18:1410338006:1.source_cn: 霍根将军真的失踪了！他会不会已经……

say:22:1410338007:0.text: Shh! As long as we haven't found his remains, don't give up.
say:22:1410338007:0.source_cn: 嘘，只要没找到他的遗骸，就别放弃。

say:23:1410338008:1.text: We dwarves are quite particular about these things. We wouldn't toss a body into the sea, nor would we stuff it into a smelting furnace.
say:23:1410338008:1.source_cn: 我们矮人在这方面还算讲究，既不会抛尸入海，也不会把尸体...

say:27:1410338009:0.text: That somehow makes it sound even worse!

say:28:1410338010:0.text: Don't talk nonsense! General Hogan wouldn't fall that easily! Maybe he's searching for us too!
say:28:1410338010:0.source_cn: 别乱说，霍根将军才不会那么容易死掉！他会不会也在四处找我们？

say:29:1410338011:0.text: What if he found the underground lift in Brimstone Village?
say:29:1410338011:0.source_cn: 也许，他也发现了深岩村有通往地下的升降机。

say:30:1410338012:0.text: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!
say:30:1410338012:0.source_cn: 有可能。主人，我们再去地下找找吧！
say:30:1410338012:0.male: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!
say:30:1410338012:0.female: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!

say:35:1410338013:0.text: Whoa, whoa! Going down is easy, but getting back up is the hard part. Are you ready for that risk? One wrong step, and it's a one-way trip!
say:35:1410338013:0.source_cn: 下去容易上来难，你们先想好。万一没有这次的好运气，就很...

choice_prompt:36:1410338013.text: Whoa, whoa! Going down is easy, but getting back up is the hard part. Are you ready for that risk? One wrong step, and it's a one-way trip!
choice_prompt:36:1410338013.source_cn: 下去容易上来难，你们先想好。万一没有这次的好运气，就很难再上来了！

say:38:1410338016:1.text: Alright then! Looks like you're stuck with me a little longer.
say:38:1410338016:1.source_cn: 好吧，我似乎还要再给你们当一阵子向导了。

say:42:1410338017:0.source_cn: 祖娅，你打算继续陪着我们吗？

say:47:1410338018:0.text: You lot have no idea how to navigate down there—I'd never forgive myself if I let you blunder your way into some death trap.
say:47:1410338018:0.source_cn: 你们在下边人生地不熟的，我也不放心就这么撇下你们啊。

say:48:1410338019:1.text: Besides, thanks to you, my research is progressing nicely! I always repay my debts. So until you find your general, I'm tagging along.
say:48:1410338019:1.source_cn: 多亏你们帮忙，我的研究才有了进展。知恩图报，在你们找到...

say:53:1410338021:0.source_cn: 那我们出发吧，去找霍根将军。

say:58:1410338022:0.text: Not so fast! We need a proper plan first.
say:58:1410338022:0.source_cn: 等等，这次我们得做好准备再去地下。

say:59:1410338023:1.text: When dwarves go mining, we always leave someone at the entrance. If things go sideways, there's at least one person topside to haul up the rescue rope.
say:59:1410338023:1.source_cn: 下矿井的时候，矮人们一定会在矿洞口留人值守，要是坑里出...

say:63:1410338024:0.text: So, you mean we need someone on the surface to coordinate in case of emergencies?
say:63:1410338024:0.source_cn: 你的意思是，为了应对意外状况，地面上得留个人手与地下里...

say:68:1410338025:0.text: Exactly! You're quite smart, little one!
say:68:1410338025:0.source_cn: 没错！孺子，呃，仓鼠可教也！

say:69:1410338026:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
say:69:1410338026:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
say:69:1410338026:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.

choice_prompt:73:1410338026.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，最好让你的两个小朋友留在地上，万一有个三长两短，他们能从外面帮上忙。
choice_prompt:73:1410338026.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
choice_prompt:73:1410338026.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.

say:74:1410338027:0.text: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!
say:74:1410338027:0.male: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!
say:74:1410338027:0.female: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!

say:75:1410338028:0.text: Chippy, don't be stubborn. He needs us up here more.
say:75:1410338028:0.source_cn: 满满，不要任性，主人更需要我们留在这里。
say:75:1410338028:0.male: Chippy, don't be stubborn. He needs us up here more.
say:75:1410338028:0.female: Chippy, don't be stubborn. She needs us up here more.

say:79:1410338032:0.text: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!
say:79:1410338032:0.source_cn: 我们也会继续寻找霍根将军，必要时我和满满会向远方求援！
say:79:1410338032:0.male: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!
say:79:1410338032:0.female: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!

say:80:1410338033:0.text: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!
say:80:1410338033:0.source_cn: 好吧……满满明白了……主人，我和漫漫会完成使命的！
say:80:1410338033:0.male: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!
say:80:1410338033:0.female: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!

say:81:1410338034:0.text: Magister, you have to come back safe!
say:81:1410338034:0.source_cn: 一定要注意安全！满满会想主人的！
say:81:1410338034:0.male: Magister, you have to come back safe!
say:81:1410338034:0.female: Magister, you have to come back safe!

say:87:1410338036:0.text: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!
say:87:1410338036:0.source_cn: 准备好了就来升降机这里找我！动作要快！
say:87:1410338036:0.male: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!
say:87:1410338036:0.female: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!

narration:94:14010346:0.text: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.
narration:94:14010346:0.source_cn: 你和满满、漫漫分头行动，而暗处的矮人们也决定分头跟踪你们。
narration:94:14010346:0.male: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.
narration:94:14010346:0.female: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.

choice:77:0:1.text: Can I trust you two with this?
choice:77:0:1.male: Can I trust you two with this?
choice:77:0:1.female: Can I trust you two with this?

choice:77:1:2.text: I know you won't let me down.
choice:77:1:2.male: I know you won't let me down.
choice:77:1:2.female: I know you won't let me down.

say:96:1410338015:0.text: A friend, huh... That's a special bond. Color me jealous.
say:96:1410338015:0.source_cn: 朋友啊……真羡慕你们的友谊。

say:4:1410341001:0.text: Zanie... someone told me they spotted a sneaky figure around here, someone who looked just like you.
say:4:1410341001:0.source_cn: 祖娅……有人告诉我，在村子里看见一个鬼鬼祟祟的家伙，和...

say:5:1410341002:0.text: I thought it was just some drunken rambling, but I never expected it to really be you.
say:5:1410341002:0.source_cn: 我还以为他是喝多了说胡话，没想到，真的是你。

say:6:1410341003:1.text: It's been a hundred years since you've been home, and now you think you can just waltz off without a word?
say:6:1410341003:1.source_cn: 一百年没回家，你连个招呼也不打就想离开？恐怕没那么容易。

say:9:1410341004:1.text: Given how our relationship is, let's skip the pleasantries.
say:9:1410341004:1.source_cn: 就凭我们这比纸还薄的关系，打招呼什么的还是免了吧。

say:15:1410341006:1.text: Sneaking off? You're spouting nonsense again!

say:22:1410341010:0.text: You've broken our village's rules. Even if you are an envoy, I'm not letting you off the hook that easily!
say:22:1410341010:0.source_cn: 公然违背深岩村的规矩，就算是特使大人，我也不能轻易放你走！
say:22:1410341010:0.male: You've broken our village's rules. Even if you are an envoy, I'm not letting you off the hook that easily!

say:25:1410341011:1.text: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?
say:25:1410341011:1.source_cn: 哼，就凭你编的那几条规矩，还想拖住耀光特使？
say:25:1410341011:1.male: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?
say:25:1410341011:1.female: Ha, do you really think your flimsy rules can stop an imperial envoy?

say:26:1410341015:1.text: Eldric, stop twisting the truth! I know what you're up to!
say:26:1410341015:1.source_cn: 弗林，你少在那颠倒黑白！我知道你打着什么算盘！

say:27:1410341016:1.text: Rebuilding the temple, resurrecting Helthor... Your actions aren't out of faith in Helthor! You just want Helthor to give you the power to wield magic yourself!
say:27:1410341016:1.source_cn: 重铸神殿，复活赫托……你的所作所为，并不是出于对赫托的...

say:30:1410341017:0.text: Exactly! I need magic! I need to wield it with my own hands! Without it, we'll never forge perfect weapons. We'll always rely on mages, on the Essail... never reaching the true peak of craftsmanship!
say:30:1410341017:0.source_cn: 没错！我需要魔法！我需要亲手使用魔法！否则我们永远无法...

say:33:1410341018:1.text: What you're doing is madness! You even dared to harm an imperial envoy! It's outright treason!
say:33:1410341018:1.source_cn: 你的做法太疯狂了！你甚至敢伤害帝国的特使！一旦帝国追究...

say:38:1410341020:0.text: Ridiculous. We're not after regime change. The Empire and all other factions will all rot away with time.
say:38:1410341020:0.source_cn: 笑话，我们要的从来就不是什么政权的更迭。帝国也好，耀光...
say:38:1410341020:0.male: Ridiculous. We're not after regime change. The Empire and all other factions will all rot away with time.

say:39:1410341021:0.text: But our dwarven craftsmanship will endure forever!

say:41:1410341022:0.text: They were just pests in the way. No one can halt the dwarves' pursuit of supreme craftsmanship!
say:41:1410341022:0.source_cn: 他们只是碍事的过客罢了。任何人，都不能阻挡我们矮人对工...
say:41:1410341022:0.male: They were just pests in the way. No one can halt the dwarves' pursuit of supreme craftsmanship!

say:42:1410341023:0.text: Look at these weapons forged from echorites, Zanie. They're already perfect... but still not enough.
say:42:1410341023:0.source_cn: 看看深岩晶制造出的武器，祖娅。它们已经很完美了，但还不够。

say:43:1410341024:0.text: If we could use magic, we could create artifacts beyond all limits. We could revive ancient techniques lost to time! That's worth fighting for!
say:43:1410341024:0.source_cn: 如果能用上魔法，我们能创造出超越一切的神器，能复兴早已...

say:46:1410341025:0.text: Are you out of your mind?! For this impossible dream, you'll drag the whole village down with you!
say:46:1410341025:0.source_cn: 你疯了吗？！为了这份不切实际的幻想，你会把整个村子都搭进去！

say:49:1410341026:0.text: When faced with the pinnacle of craftsmanship... family, friends, country... <shk>None of it matters!</shk>
say:49:1410341026:0.source_cn: 在至高的技艺面前……亲人，朋友，国家……<shk>全都...

say:52:1410341027:0.text: Stop chasing your delusions! Helthor cannot be resurrected!
say:52:1410341027:0.source_cn: 别再做你那美梦了！我根本不相信赫托能被复活！

say:55:1410341028:0.text: Without magic, we're just ordinary tinkers! Doomed to mediocrity! Don't you want to bring back the glory of the past?!
say:55:1410341028:0.source_cn: 无法使用魔法的我们，终究只是平凡庸俗的创造者！你不想恢...

say:58:1410341029:0.text: I do... but not through these methods!
say:58:1410341029:0.source_cn: 我想……但我不认同你的做法！我有自己的打算！

say:61:1410341030:0.text: Then there's nothing more to say. The future of the dwarves is coming, and you... you'll be cast into the slag!
say:61:1410341030:0.source_cn: 那就没什么好说的了！矮人的未来即将来临，而你，将会被抛...

choice:40:0:1.source_cn: 所以你杀了那些调查员？

choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 所以你们矮人并不是真的谋逆？
